notes.title: Cooking & Fishing system - Work in progress!🐟
notes.content:
We told you about it; we are working on the fishing & cooking system, which goes hand in hand.  First you fish, then you cook, seems good right?  🍣

Cooking will bring more depth to the game by giving you bonuses when you explore the different biomes. Different foods will have different effects, and to cook well, you need ingredients, including fish.  🦐

These fish will be collectable in the various biomes. But worry not, you’ll have a full introduction to fishing & cooking directly in-game with different new characters that will be there to help you!  Nothing fishy, we promise! (That one was easy.)🦑


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45409328/d2ccfadf4eb8ac570f4a123938e2ad8469590611.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45409328/805c6bccb14d22499a594b9d1dffc3328c09109b.png[/img]

[i]Example of fish you could find, but also one of your future fishing mentors![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45409328/2ee77ac03c820c90501f3d08683ffa44c5aafe5b.png[/img]


Fishing includes a lot of bugs, but we’re fixing this. So no, don’t try to fish in Venom’s water bowl! 👀

Are you as excited as we are for this update? Tell us what you think in the comments! ✨

notes.title: Demo 2.0
notes.content:
[h1]New demo update![/h1]

[b]Also, our Kickstarter campaign is ending soon, get access to the closed beta starting Early December by taking the "Registry Manager" reward tier or above![/b]

Support us now on https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/teamcraftstudios/teamcrafter?ref=6pk2rd

[h2]New stuff[/h2]
- New Favour talent that increases Piety and celerity, can be found on[b]Maple key[/b][/p][p]- New rain of arrows VFX [b]for Archer[/b][/p][p]- Only one of each talent is allowed per adventurer now, if the same talent is present twice, the one with highest level will apply
- New tutorial with less intensive math
- Pendulum relic has been reworked
- Hard wood, Wood log and Dragon Fly energies have been adjusted
- New petting animation for the main character
- New loading screen splash, more splash images to come!
- New button in fight screen to change fight speed
- Game Over screen now shows your last try logs
- Reward screen now shows recipe's implicits too
- New [b]Unique[/b] resource
- New SFX for Rain of Arrows, Healing Choir and legendary drops adjustments
- More animals in biomes, they're still not as active as they're going to be in the future, please look forward to it!

[h2]Nerfs[/h2]
- Soul barrier talent has been nerfed
- Alembic, Lorgnette, Broken bell, Odd Hourglass, Stress ball relics have been nerfed
- Titan necklace has been nerfed from 1% POW per Flora energy to -2% POW per Flora energy
- Void Scepter now gives -1% chaos res per solar

[h2]Buffs[/h2]
- Domino, haunting whistle and antidote relics have been buffed
- Faith talent has been buffed
- Soul Pact and Overclocking talents have been buffed
- Medlar tree is now more commonly found in plain biome
- Base character movespeed increased by 5
- Andarta's base damage is now 7,500 (was 5,000)
- Doubled the amount of Buried Spots in Swamp biome

[h2]Bugfixes and misc[/h2]
- "not enough mana" log line is now red in fight logs
- New water shader ! 
- Relic tooltip now properly shows the # you currently own
- Celerity can no longer go below 0.5
- Spamming hit no longer results in stuck character
- Mana cost modifier now properly applies to adventurer and their stats sheet
- Dodge modifier (Evasion talent) is now effective, used to apply a +15% bonus to the base value, now adds 15% dodge chances

notes.title: Teamcrafter is now on Kickstarter!
notes.content: [p]It's finally time for us to start it: The Kickstarter campaign for Teamcrafter is live![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45409328/f831dfb2aadb2cf3673e23f05701556886a9a685.png"][/img][/p][p][i]You can also now play the demo for free, which we'll update through the campaign with more content, lore, quests, etc[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Rewards start at €20 to get a Steam copy of the game and higher tier rewards include exclusive skins, pet, the ability to add a name to the automatically generated adventurer names pool, the opponrtunity to design part of the game with us and even handmade knives by a member of our team![/p][p][/p][p]Our goal for Teamcrafter is to [b]not rely on publishers[/b]: to be able to fund the game alone, without any pressure from a publisher to make whatever benefits they need for a quota; to be considered a profitable project; a game that's allowed to be alive until it's no longer profitable.[/p][p]This campaign is a way for us to [b]fund the game we want to make[/b], not the game someone else wants us to create for profit.[/p][p][/p][p]Support us now on [/p][p][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/teamcraftstudios/teamcrafter?ref=6pk2rd"]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/teamcraftstudios/teamcrafter?ref=6pk2rd[/url][/p][p][/p]
